decisions.reason: The existing message-24 MODIFY already captures the cleaner left arm without a conventional Roman flare; adding left_arm_termination would duplicate the same semantic change.
The terminal change applies to the Hero V under active refinement and does not independently determine the second V form; its existing message-24 prerequisite remains sufficient.
The cleaner Hero V left-arm termination does not necessarily change the deferred accent form, and the source does not specify how that termination should propagate to the accent.
The source refines one arm of the Hero V and does not change the deferred construction or visual language of the remaining wordmark letterforms.
The geometric terminal refinement does not alter the deferred champagne-metal material treatment, its qualities, or its application sequence.
Changing the Hero V left-arm termination does not alter the deferred wordmark kerning, composition rhythm, or visual hierarchy requirements.
The source applies the existing structural and non-decorative brand direction to a specific Hero V detail without changing the broader brand-expression state.
The Hero V terminal refinement does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
